items.t: Authored a bill to create the Great Redwood Trail, which would extend from the San Francisco Bay to the Humboldt Bay.
items.q: Senator Mike McGuire’s groundbreaking bill that will create the Great Redwood Trail, which will extend from the San Francisco Bay to the Humboldt Bay, is one step closer to reality

label: Written by AI from public sources — may contain errors.
bio: Mike McGuire was elected to the California State Senate in 2014, and re-elected in 2018 and again in 2022. He became the Majority Leader in 2022, and served as President pro Tempore of the Senate.
